Definition: from G4253 and G2036; to say already, to predict:--forewarn, say (speak, tell) before. Compare G4280.
BiblicalUsage: Proepo means to say already, to tell before, and the King James reads it in three places. Peter says the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, Paul tells the Galatians before as he has told them in time past, and the Thessalonians hear that Paul also forewarned them. The commoner spelling of the same verb carries the other verses, but these three are this word's own.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God speaks before events so that when they come, his people know whose hand is in them.
